messages:
Ashley (CS): Harbor Retail is ready to ramp a pilot in APAC and asked for a provisional allowlist + temporary rate bump. They want 200 qps for the demo window starting tomorrow 08:00 SGT. Can NetOps provision and confirm egress region?
Devon (NetOps): looping in. need CIDRs + duration. also, are they on Dedicated or Hosted for this pilot?
Ashley (CS): Hosted. customer id: HRB-2981. CIDRs they provided: 203.110.120.0/22 and 45.77.200.128/25. Duration requested: 72h starting 2026-05-12T08:00+08:00.
Mike (AM): renewal on this account is due in 6 weeks, pilot performance directly impacts upsell — please mark as high touch. If we can show low latency in APAC it'll help.
Elaine (Support): quick note: they reported 429 spikes yesterday when traffic routed through EU edge. Confirming APAC route should reduce errors.
Devon (NetOps): OK. Can do allowlist + a temporary rate-limit policy to 200 qps for the two CIDRs. We'll create a scoped route to ap-southeast-1 edge. Auto-revoke after 72h unless CS requests extension.
Ashley (CS): perfect. please include an autorevoke tag so we don't forget. also add a canary rollout for first 10 minutes at 50% traffic to watch for errors.
Devon (NetOps): noted. config I plan to apply:
```
allowlist: ["203.110.120.0/22", "45.77.200.128/25"]
route: ap-southeast-1
rate_limit_override: 200 qps
autorevoke: 72h
canary: {duration: 10m, pct: 50}
```
Elaine (Support): can we add a monitoring hook to send alerts to #customer-health and to the account slack channel if >1% 5xxs in 5m?
Devon (NetOps): yep will add SLO alert. hooking to #customer-health and paging if severity high.
ops-bot: Change request created: CR-20260512-998 — allowlist + rate override for HRB-2981. Scheduled apply: 2026-05-12T07:50:00Z (10m canary). Owner: Devon.
Mike (AM): tagging product-ops: if the demo goes well I'll request a Dedicated proof-of-concept; we need metrics on tokens/latency and cost delta.
Ashley (CS): I'll run the enablement playbook with Harbor and provide the prompt set for quality checks. also will capture feedback during the canary.
Devon (NetOps): deployment plan: pre-checks at 07:30 UTC, apply allowlist at 07:50 UTC, canary 10m -> monitor, full rollout at 08:00 SGT if healthy. Rolling back will remove the override and revert route.
deploy-bot: Deploy job queued: deploy/edge-route/CR-20260512-998. ETA 20m.
Elaine (Support): I'll standby on the support channel during the rollout and handle any customer-side troubleshooting.
Mike (AM): marked as high-priority for renewal follow-up. I'll join the post-demo review.
Ashley (CS): thanks team — please paste the final applied config & ticket link here once done, and I'll confirm with Harbor. :thumbsup:
Devon (NetOps): will do. CR link: https://redwood.ops/changes/CR-20260512-998 — will paste applied config after apply.
ops-bot: CR-20260512-998: status changed to SCHEDULED.
Devon (NetOps): applied. final config snapshot copied to ticket. APAC route verified and traffic flowed in canary with 0.2% 5xx. Full rollout at 08:00 SGT, no issues observed. Auto-revoke scheduled 72h from rollout.
Ashley (CS): Reported to Harbor — they verified lower latency and no 429s in the first hour. I'll capture additional feedback and open a renewal conversation after the pilot. :rocket:
